_comment: Per-project Claude Code settings written by /ar-install. AUTONOMOUS posture: the agentic flow (ar-taskflow and friends) runs end to end without stopping for permission prompts. defaultMode 'acceptEdits' auto-accepts file edits; the allow list covers the git + build + PR operations the flow performs; there is intentionally NO 'ask' list, so the flow never blocks on a routine action. Only genuinely destructive commands are denied. The SessionStart workflow hook and the default-branch / force-push guard are installed GLOBALLY by the framework's install.sh, so they are not duplicated here; they still apply. To run non-autonomously, add operations to an 'ask' array.
